title: Sales Engineer
summary: Visit sites, size hot water systems and prepare quotations for hotels, hospitals and buildings.
about: You'll be the technical face of DPY for hotels, hospitals and buildings: visiting sites, working out which hot water system a building needs, and turning that into a clear quotation.
duties: Visit project sites with clients and our engineers
Size hot water systems: heat pumps, storage tanks, pumps and pipes
Prepare quotations and technical proposals
Follow up with developers, contractors and building owners
Hand over won projects to our installation team
requirements: Graduate of mechanical or electrical engineering; a licence is a plus
Comfortable explaining technical options to people who are not engineers
Willing to travel to project sites
Experience in plumbing, HVAC or MEP sales is an advantage

title: Sales Executive
summary: Look after homeowners, developers and retail clients, from first inquiry to installation.
about: You'll look after homeowners, developers and retail clients from their first inquiry to a finished installation, and keep in touch after the sale.
duties: Answer inquiries by phone, Messenger and email
Recommend the right heater for each home or business
Prepare quotations and follow them through
Arrange deliveries and installations with our team
Keep clients informed after the sale
requirements: Experience in sales or customer service
Clear communicator in English and Filipino
Organised, with good follow-through
At ease with email, spreadsheets and messaging apps

title: Accounting Staff
summary: Keep our books, billing and payments accurate and on time.
about: You'll keep our books, billing and payments accurate and on time, working closely with our sales and service teams.
duties: Prepare invoices and record collections
Process supplier payments
Reconcile bank accounts
Help prepare reports and tax filings with our accountant
requirements: Graduate of accountancy or a related course
Familiar with Philippine bookkeeping and BIR forms
Careful with detail and deadlines
At ease with spreadsheets and accounting software

title: Aircon Technician
summary: Install and service heat pumps and refrigeration-based systems on site.
about: You'll install and service heat pumps and other refrigeration-based hot water systems on site, as part of our technical team.
duties: Install heat pump water heaters with our team
Start up new systems and check the refrigerant and electrical connections
Carry out preventive maintenance and repairs
Show clients how to use their system
requirements: Experience installing or servicing aircon or refrigeration units
TESDA certification in refrigeration and aircon servicing is a plus
Safety-minded, at ease on rooftops and in plant rooms
Willing to travel to sites
